pretraining_mptrj.description: AlphaNet-L (16.2M parameters) is trained on the MPTraj dataset (1,580,395 structures from DFT relaxations of 154,719 Materials Project materials) with MAE loss, learning rate 1e-4, 6 layers, 24 heads, 256 hidden channels, 256 num basis, 6Å cutoff, batch size 12, for 200 epochs. Training cost is 243 GPU days with 10.1 GB memory per sample. The model is then evaluated on the Matbench Discovery WBM test set.

training_oc2m.description: AlphaNet (6.1M parameters) is trained on the OC2M subset (approximately 2 million configurations) for 2,000,000 steps with MAE loss, learning rate 1e-4, 4 layers, 16 heads, 256 hidden channels, 96 num basis, 5Å cutoff, batch size 4, for 130 epochs. Energy loss weight λE is set to 4 (or 20 for better energy accuracy), force loss weight λF is 100. Training cost is 361 GPU days with 5.1 GB memory per sample. The model achieves 0.25 eV energy MAE and 0.040 eV/Å force MAE on the OC20 validation set.
